_readme: Every font/size/weight/line-height/letter-spacing used on the site, structured for easy scanning. See reference/typography.md for the same data as prose/tables if you want more explanation of the 'why'. Two page types exist: 'token-driven' pages read values from css/tokens.css (edit tokens.json/tokens section once, every token-driven page updates); 'bespoke' pages hardcode their own px values in their own CSS file (edit that page's own file directly, tokens.css has no effect on it).

tokens.note: Shared source for every 'token-driven' page. A value here is the definition, not a copy.

--font-mono.usedFor: body text, labels, nav, everything else

--fs-label.usedFor: kickers, meta text, footer, uppercase tags

--fs-intro.usedFor: Design System page intro paragraph only

--fs-section-num.usedFor: Design System page section digits only

tokens.responsiveNote: No breakpoint overrides live in tokens.css — the clamp() display sizes already scale continuously. Layout, not type, is what changes at breakpoints on token-driven pages.

caseStudyTeaser.note: All three public case-study teaser pages use this exact same type system. Only --accent color and a couple of max-width values differ per page — see each page's 'differencesFromTemplate' below.
